targets.rawSql: SELECT ta.relayer AS provider, count() AS transactions, round(sum(gt.fee_sol), 4) AS total_fees_sol, round(avg(gt.fee_sol), 7) AS avg_fee_sol FROM default.geyser_transactions gt ARRAY JOIN arrayConcat(gt.static_unsigned_writable_accounts, gt.loaded_writable_accounts) AS acct INNER JOIN default.tip_accounts ta ON ta.tip_account = acct WHERE gt.is_vote = 0 AND gt.ingested_at > now() - INTERVAL 30 MINUTE GROUP BY provider ORDER BY transactions DESC

SELECT ta.relayer AS provider, count() AS transactions FROM default.geyser_transactions gt ARRAY JOIN arrayConcat(gt.static_unsigned_writable_accounts, gt.loaded_writable_accounts) AS acct INNER JOIN default.tip_accounts ta ON ta.tip_account = acct WHERE gt.is_vote = 0 AND gt.ingested_at > now() - INTERVAL 30 MINUTE GROUP BY provider ORDER BY transactions DESC

SELECT ta.relayer AS provider, round(sum(gt.fee_sol), 4) AS total_fees_sol FROM default.geyser_transactions gt ARRAY JOIN arrayConcat(gt.static_unsigned_writable_accounts, gt.loaded_writable_accounts) AS acct INNER JOIN default.tip_accounts ta ON ta.tip_account = acct WHERE gt.is_vote = 0 AND gt.ingested_at > now() - INTERVAL 30 MINUTE GROUP BY provider ORDER BY total_fees_sol DESC
